what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in Austria, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 11270 Somali refugees in Austria, 1.3% of all refugees from Somalia.
Kenya and Ethiopia host the most Somali refugees, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia from 1993 to 1996, in 2001 to 2002 and in every year from 2006 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
From 2006 the government's opponents it records include ARS/UIC, Al-Shabaab and Hizbul Islam.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1998 at 43 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Austria.
These are year-end totals for Austria only, reported to UNHCR.
